channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Kevon Looney | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Kevon Looney from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Draymond Green on Kevon Looney
item.description:
Draymond Green on Kevon Looney:

“The most professional teammate I've ever had in my life. Not NBA, not college, not high school.”

Draymond Green on Kevon Looney, Jun 11, 2024. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Mychal Thompson on Draymond Green, Kevon Looney
item.description:
.... Mychal Thompson:

“It makes sense. For him, Draymond and Steph should never wear another uniform. Or should never have to wear another uniform. That also goes for Kevon Looney, too. That boy is a Warrior through and through. He needs to retire as a Warrior after another 10 or 12 more years, too.”

Mychal Thompson on Draymond Green, Kevon Looney, Aug 30, 2023. Source: SportsKeeda.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Kevon Looney
item.description:
Madeline Kenney:Steve Kerr on Kevon Looney:

“I think Loon is one of the best centers in the league, I really do. And people don't recognzie it becasue he's not dunking and shooting 3s and all that stuff. This guy is a flat-out winner and he's a machine. We wouldn't be here without him.”

Steve Kerr on Kevon Looney, Apr 30, 2023. Source: Twitter @madkenney.

item.title: Draymond Green on Andre Iguodala, Shaun Livingston, Kevon Looney
item.description:
Draymond Green:

“Kevon (Looney) has become like an Andre Iguodala, Shaun Livingston, a calming force.”

Draymond Green on Andre Iguodala, Shaun Livingston, Kevon Looney, Apr 27, 2023. Source: Twitter @anthonyVslater.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Kevon Looney
item.description:
Anthony Slater:Steve Kerr on Kevon Looney:

“I didn't play him enough in Game 3.That was my mistake.”

Steve Kerr on Kevon Looney, Jun 10, 2022. Source: Twitter @anthonyVslater.

item.title: James Wiseman on Kevon Looney
item.description:
James Wiseman told Monte Poole this week on the Dubs Talk podcast.

“Which spots he likes to get to in terms of his shots. Just studying a lot of film. When I was on the bench, I used to look at Loon [Kevon Looney] and how he was able to affect everything.”

James Wiseman on Kevon Looney, Jun 18, 2021. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Stephen Curry on Kevon Looney
item.description:
Drew Shiller:Steph Curry on how helpful Kevon Looney's screening is to the Warriors' offense:

“There's an art and a science to it. There's a chemistry to it. You have to go through the reps to understand what it's like. Loon has been there.”

Stephen Curry on Kevon Looney, Jan 26, 2021. Source: Twitter @DrewShiller.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Kevon Looney
item.description:
Connor Letourneau:Kerr:

“I think everyone knows that Looney is kind of a personal favorite of mine.”

Steve Kerr on Kevon Looney, Dec 9, 2020. Source: Twitter @Con_Chron.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Kevon Looney
item.description:
Steve Kerr on Kevon Looney:

“Three straight days of scrimmaging, a lot of work and he's feeling excellent. That's a huge sign for us of a huge guy we can count in a big situation being healthy, unlike last year.”

Steve Kerr on Kevon Looney, Dec 9, 2020. Source: Twitter @anthonyVslater.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Kevon Looney, Marquese Chriss, James Wiseman
item.description:
Connor Letourneau:Steve Kerr on a center rotation of Wiseman, Looney and Chriss:

“We anticipate all three of them playing. As always, we'll figure out who starts as we go.”

Steve Kerr on Kevon Looney, Marquese Chriss, James Wiseman, Dec 1, 2020. Source: Twitter @Con_Chron.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Kevon Looney
item.description:
Connor Letourneau:Steve Kerr on Kevon Looney:

“He's done more the last week. He's playing one-on-one right now on the practice floor. Rick (Celebrini) says he's coming along. I don't have a possible date for his return.”

Steve Kerr on Kevon Looney, Jan 16, 2020. Source: Twitter @Con_Chron.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Andrew Bogut, Kevon Looney
item.description:
Mark Medina:Steve Kerr on handling minutes for Andrew Bogut and Kevon Looney:

“Bogut and Kevon have been fantastic. Both are playing at a very high level. If I didn’t play those guys, I'd be an idiot.”

Steve Kerr on Andrew Bogut, Kevon Looney, Apr 21, 2019. Source: Twitter @MarkG_Medina.

item.title: Andre Iguodala on Kevon Looney
item.description:
Anthony Slater:Andre Iguodala on Kevon Looney this summer:

“I hope he gets paid,so I hope he doesn’t come back because I hope he gets all the money.”

Andre Iguodala on Kevon Looney, Apr 19, 2019. Source: Twitter @anthonyVslater.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Kevon Looney
item.description:
Connor Letourneau:Kerr on Looney:

“I think he’s gonna have a good 10 or 12 year run in the NBA.”

Steve Kerr on Kevon Looney, Oct 1, 2018. Source: Twitter @Con_Chron.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Kevon Looney
item.description:
Connor Letourneau:Kerr on Kevon Looney:

“He was probably the best player in practice today in terms of his overall effort and how he played. He was great.”

Steve Kerr on Kevon Looney, Oct 15, 2017. Source: Twitter @Con_Chron.

item.title: Austin Ainge on Kevon Looney
item.description:
Marc D'Amico:Austin Ainge on Kevon Looney:

“For a 19-year-old kid he’s got a lot of tools... I just think the combination of length and skill is unique.”

Austin Ainge on Kevon Looney, Jun 17, 2015. Source: Twitter @celtics.
